symptom: ako/mxcli#1863 / mendixlabs/mxcli#1705: `/** Why */` above `alter entity M.E add attribute X: String(200);` — exec reports "Added attribute", describe shows X with no documentation; only a later `check` warns MDL089
cause: The alter visitor reads a doc comment written INSIDE the alter (before `add`, or after `attribute`); the statement-level comment, the place a user writes it, was recorded as detached by exitStatementDocs and applied to nothing
fix: exitStatementDocs gives the statement's doc comment to the added attribute when the alter (or bulk `alter entities`) adds exactly one attribute with no comment of its own; otherwise it stays detached and MDL089 still warns
test: mdl/visitor TestAlterAddAttributeStatementDocComment (alter entity + alter entities, controls: attribute's own comment wins, two adds stay detached). Fails on main with documentation "" and one detached comment; end-to-end on PedApp 11.13 describe shows `/** Why */` above X after the fix and none before
insight: The 2026-07-30 fix (traceops #27) made the comment parse between clauses and believed the gap closed, but tested only the clause position. MDL089 lists exactly the statement-level comments nothing reads, so it doubles as a census of this bug class: any statement whose MDL089 warning a user would reasonably expect to be stored is a drop, not a misplacement
